summary: tslint-folder-schema preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs", which runs on npm install. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the bun binary, marks it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync to run the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle featuring a string-array rotation routine (WV8StW) and hex-obfuscated identifiers, and it is unrelated to the package's stated purpose of providing a tslint folder-structure rule. Fetching a second language runtime and using it to execute a large obfuscated sibling file at install time bypasses Node-based install-time inspection. Package metadata reinforces the mismatch: the homepage points to github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint while the author is a personal gmail address (Andrey Trofimov <aegaeon51@gmail.com>), and none of the shipped install-time code is consistent with the advertised tslint rule.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
